segments.text: V. 10. And whether ye have more or leſs, ſee that ye be faithful as well as wiſe Stewards. He that is faithful in what is meaneſt of all, wordly Subſtance, is alſo faithful in Things of an higher Nature: And he that uſes theſe loweſt Gifts unfaithfully, is likewiſe unfaithful in ſpiritual Things.
